title: bytekode
tagline: Custom block explorers for your DApps and Wallets
description:
web3fyi is a developer tooling platform simplifying blockchain based transactions to build intuitive user interfaces for dapp developers with a vision of becoming an L2 + L1 Block explorer and Analytics platform with open-source sdks to drive mass adoption to web3.

The current state of Dapp Interaction involves signing complicated transaction messages via wallets(usually browser extensions such as Metamask), and verifying these transactions on block explorers(eg: Etherscan) that is not very user friendly for non crypto users.

Complicated UX is very repulsive for new users that are already accustomed to the friendly UX of web2, by solving this UX problem, we can onboard more people to web3.

Existing block explorers and analytics platforms are mainly targeting web3-native users. Their platforms are still very difficult to understand for someone very new to web3(and usually has a higher learning curve).

We’re buiding bytekode, keeping in mind the ease of usabililty of web2 platforms, and building for non native web3 users.
how_its_made: Since each user interacts with multiple contracts in their transactions, getting the ABI, bytecode & mapping it to produce legible notifications is very tricky
